entities.name: Saint Paraskevi church in Kwiatoń
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Paraskevi Church in Kwiatoń is a Gothic, wooden church located in the village of Kwiatoń from the nineteenth-century, which together with different tserkvas is designated as part of the UNESCO Wooden tserkvas of the Carpathian region in Poland and Ukraine.
